knimeNode.name: Rank Pareto Solutions
knimeNode.shortDescription: Ranks multi-objective solutions and estimates their diversity.

fullDescription.intro: Reads every objective, direction, and constraint definition automatically from Problem Setup. It adds constraint-aware Pareto rank and crowding distance for NSGA-II, GDE3, archives, analysis, or custom survivor strategies.

ports.outPort: Population with Pareto rank and crowding distance.
